description: This PHP class defines the LeaveRequest entity within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It maps to the 'ohrm_leave_request' database table and encapsulates properties such as leave type, application date, associated employee, and related leave entries. The class uses Doctrine ORM annotations for object-relational mapping and includes methods for accessing and modifying its properties.

classes.name: LeaveRequest
classes.description: Entity class representing a leave request, with properties for leave type, application date, employee, and related leaves. Implements Doctrine ORM mappings and includes getter and setter methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the leave request.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the leave request.

methods.name: getLeaveType
methods.description: Retrieves the leave type associated with this request.

methods.name: setLeaveType
methods.description: Assigns a leave type to this request.

methods.name: getDateApplied
methods.description: Returns the date when the leave was applied for.

methods.name: setDateApplied
methods.description: Sets the date of leave application.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Gets the employee who made the leave request.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Assigns an employee to this leave request.

methods.name: getLeaves
methods.description: Returns the collection of leave entries associated with this request.

methods.name: setLeaves
methods.description: Assigns a collection of leave entries to this request.
